voices.note: the mishna opening perek הזרוע והלחיים (130a.1-7)

props.gloss_en: the foreleg, the jaw and the maw apply in the Land and outside the Land
in the presence of the Temple and not in the presence of the Temple
all consecrated animals whose permanent blemish preceded their consecration, and which were redeemed, are obligated in the firstborn [law] and in the gifts
and they go out to non-sacred status to be shorn and to be worked
and their offspring and their milk are permitted after their redemption
and one who slaughters them outside is exempt
and they do not make a substitute
and if they died, they are redeemed
except for the firstborn and the tithe

all whose consecration preceded their blemish, or a passing blemish preceded their consecration and afterwards a permanent blemish arose in them, and which were redeemed, are exempt from the firstborn [law] and from the gifts
and they do not go out to non-sacred status to be shorn and to be worked
and their offspring and their milk are forbidden after their redemption
and one who slaughters them outside is liable
and if they died, they are buried

schemas.gloss_en: שהיה בדין: if non-sacred animals, which are not obligated in breast and thigh, are obligated in the gifts, consecrated animals, which are obligated in breast and thigh -- is it not right that they be obligated in the gifts?
